what: The watch registry (Madhav, 2026-10-03: a set of rules watching plus an eye-like tracker, kept in sections; one scanner unless a watch needs a faster loop). Every watch Ananta runs is declared here once: its section, the candle it decides on, how it triggers, where it runs, its entry, exit and size, which evidence book its trades go to, its evidence status, and who hears about it. A rule written here before its trades happen is its pre-registration: the live trades that follow are clean forward evidence.
how_to_add: 1) write the rule (entry, exit, size) here with today's date; 2) test it on history in the repair shop if it can be; 3) give it a rule function in the place named by runs_in (jarvis.watch_engine for daily bar-close rules, jarvis.eye for live price levels); 4) its trades appear on the scoreboard by themselves. A watch that needs other data (order book) or heavy compute gets its own process.

loops.bar_close: Rules on closed candles (15 minutes, 1 hour, 1 day) only change when a candle closes, so they are checked right after each close: the Explorer every 15 minutes, the hourly watch each hour, the daily engine after each daily close (8 pm Toronto).
loops.level_cross: The eye: live prices every 10 seconds, checked against levels the slower sections arm (zone edges, your stops and alerts, a sudden Bitcoin drop). It catches a cross within seconds instead of at the next candle close.
loops.schedule: Once a day or on request (news check, briefs, credit records).

sections.name: Market weather
sections.job: Is the market allowed to be long at all? The first gate for everything else.

sections.name: Coin structure and zones
sections.job: Is the coin in its own uptrend, and where is price: inside, entering or far from a zone that matters?

sections.name: Setups
sections.job: Did a specific entry pattern happen? Each one trades $100 on paper in its own evidence book.

sections.name: Risk and exits
sections.job: Protect what is open: stops, targets, the kill switch.

sections.name: News and events
sections.job: The blunder guard and the things you asked to be told about.

sections.name: Jarvis's decisions
sections.job: One brain weighs every flagged moment with everything we know and trades its own paper book; findings, not more watches.

sections.name: Baselines
sections.job: Random entries with the same exits: every watch must beat these after costs to count.

watches.name: Bitcoin 50-day rule (market allowed or risk-off)
watches.evidence: V02 KEEP, H01 SUPPORTED; at zones 68% held with it vs 50% without (review #7)

watches.name: Sudden Bitcoin drop
watches.entry: Bitcoin falls 2% or more within 15 minutes
watches.evidence: a warning, not a signal: the six Explorer trades stopped out on Oct 2 all went in one 25-minute drop

watches.name: Market shift (Bitcoin crossing its 50-day)
watches.entry: live: Bitcoin's price 0.3% past its 50-day average against the current regime (a warning: 'if the day closes here...'); daily close: the regime flipped
watches.evidence: the strongest single fact we have (review #7); it decides the trend portfolio and the market-gated setups
watches.alerts: phone (live: once per direction every 12 hours; each flip at the close)

watches.name: Trend portfolio (T3)
watches.entry: hold a coin while its daily close is above its 20- and 50-day averages and Bitcoin is above its 50-day; equal weights
watches.exit: the coin or Bitcoin loses those averages; weekly rebalance
watches.evidence: review #4 PASS: +13% vs buy-and-hold -22% (2024-26), half the drawdown

watches.name: Trend portfolio (T3), 30-coin paper tier
watches.entry: hold a coin while its daily close is above its 20- and 50-day averages and Bitcoin is above its 50-day; equal weights
watches.exit: the coin or Bitcoin loses those averages; weekly rebalance
watches.evidence: review #15 PASS on TOP30 (+19.0% vs buy-and-hold -23.7%, 2024-Jul 2026), FAIL on all 120; Madhav 2026-10-04: paper slot, separate

watches.name: Zone entries recorded with how they ended
watches.entry: a daily candle comes down into a support zone
watches.exit: HELD / BROKEN after up to 20 days (review #6 rule)
watches.evidence: review #6: zones hold a little more often than random bands

watches.name: Price entering a zone (live)
watches.entry: the live price comes down into the nearest support zone
watches.evidence: starts the lookout the moment it happens instead of at the daily close
watches.alerts: phone when the coin's attention is HIGH (once per coin per 6 hours); feed always

watches.name: Zone touch in an allowed market
watches.entry: the live price comes down into a support zone of a kind history supports (200-day average, overlapping zones, a new swing; review #6) while Bitcoin is above its 50-day average; one at a time per coin, not the same zone twice in 20 days; buy $100 at the live price
watches.exit: stop half a daily range under the zone (checked live and on daily lows), else sell at the open 20 days later
watches.evidence: untested as a trade: zones held a little more often than random (review #6) and the market gate mattered most (review #7); registered 2026-10-03 before any trade, so its live trades are clean forward evidence

watches.name: Short dip trade (RSI dip in an uptrend)
watches.entry: close above the 200-day average and RSI(10) under 30; buy $100 at the next day's open; one at a time per coin
watches.exit: the next open after a close with RSI(10) over 40, or the open 10 days after entry; no stop
watches.evidence: review #14 PROMISING: beat ordinary uptrend days with the same exit in both periods, a few events short

watches.name: Short dip trade (H07), 30-coin paper tier
watches.entry: close above the 200-day average and RSI(10) under 30; buy $100 at the next day's open; one at a time per coin
watches.exit: the next open after a close with RSI(10) over 40, or the open 10 days after entry; no stop
watches.evidence: review #15 PASS on TOP30 (33 events, +6.0% excess, z 3.5; confirm +3.6%, z 3.2), FAIL on all 120; Madhav 2026-10-04: paper slot, separate

watches.alerts: phone when down (reminder every 3 hours) and when back

watches.entry: your 'tell me when this setup completes' alerts
watches.evidence: your own rules

watches.name: Daily news check (blunder guard)
watches.entry: one AI news check per coin per day after the close, HIGH attention coins first
watches.evidence: review #5 exploratory: flags asset-specific damage; recorded point-in-time from 2026-10-03

watches.name: Jarvis's own decisions
watches.entry: woken by a zone entry (the eye), a setup firing (Explorer, daily watches, Hunter), a coin turning HIGH attention or the market turning allowed; the model weighs the evidence pack and writes the plan first; code enforces the red flags (no price, bad stop, AVOID news, already holding); at most 20 decisions a day, one per coin every 6 hours, 8 open; buy $100 at the live price (its chosen size kept as 'sized')
watches.exit: its own plan: stop, target or trailing stop (daily ranges) on the live price, else the open after its time limit (2-30 days)
watches.evidence: new 2026-10-04: forward paper evidence only; judged against its random twins (JARVIS_RANDOM) by independent events

watches.exit: the same exits as the real trades

watches.evidence: the bar for Jarvis's decisions: same moment, same plan, no judgement
